021S.consumed_boundary: Environment promotion, desired/observed deployment state, progressive rollout, health gates, partial rollout, rollback/roll-forward mechanics and convergence remain 021S-owned.
021S.residual: Current 021S target/runtime requalification remains outside F-WP-010.

021U.consumed_boundary: Incident declaration/severity/command/containment/review truth remains 021U-owned; F-WP-010 consumes standing and writes correlation/review references only.

021T.consumed_boundary: Raw telemetry/health observations remain 021T-owned; missing telemetry is a metric gap and cannot fabricate success or zero.

021H.consumed_boundary: Admission/capacity/resource standing remains 021H-owned and is consumed read-only with freshness/expiry.

021W.consumed_boundary: Workload/performance objective semantics remain 021W-owned; F-WP-010 emits only versioned change metric observations.

021Y.consumed_boundary: Provider standing and exit/concentration implications remain 021Y-owned; restricted/prohibited/unknown are never promoted to eligible.

021Z_output_boundary.consumed_boundary: Post-change corrective-action review is represented only as an external authority reference; F-WP-010 does not implement control-assurance/remediation authority.

hard_rule: These are read-only specialist boundary adapters. F-WP-010 neither implements nor closes 021S/U/T/H/W/Y/Z and cannot manufacture specialist standing.
